property_summary: After calling create(bytes,address) with a non-zero encodedParameters and a valid ownedBy address, the reference contract retains the original roundImplementation value (non-zero), while the buggy version sets roundImplementation to address(0), causing a subsequent call to create(bytes,address) with the same parameters to revert in the buggy version due to the zero address check.
change_summary: Change newRoundImplementation assignment to use address(0) instead of the parameter
